title: Nine Winters of Mending
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：coat　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 coat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my mother was sent to mend ① coat she could not replace, and she said the mending was the whole of the lesson. The ② coat, meaning the garment and not the wool, was nine winters old and was mended by whoever came last; coat, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ coat in that house had the same button, and the ④ coat at the end, meaning the one the tailor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mended properly. Coat, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ coat was the whole of the winter, meaning the warmth it carried and not the garment. The ⑥ coat, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody borrows and nobody questions; coat, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a garment and warmth. She said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ coat had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the button. The ⑧ coat of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine winters and eleven years of mending; coat, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ coat I remember is the one at the end, which was mended in 1968 and is still described as the warmest in the county. A ⑩ coat, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every coat, she said, is warmth that has agreed to look like a garment. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 外套（指那件衣服本身，与那些羊毛相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend a coat 缝补一件外套
D. n. 外套（指那栋房子里每一件）
E. n. 外套（指末尾那一件）
F. n. 温暖（抽象：它带来的那份暖意）
G. n. 那份暖意（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The coat, meaning the garment and not the wool
coat was the whole of the winter
the coat had become a number in a report
The coat of the whole thing
A coat, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: mend a coat 意为“缝补一件外套”，1948 年母亲被派去补她换不起的那件外套。
coat 意为“外套、大衣”，指那件衣服本身而不是那些羊毛，穿了九个冬天，由最后来的人补。
coat 指那栋房子里每一件外套，每一件都是同样的纽扣。
coat 指末尾那一件（裁缝留下的那一件），是唯一有人认真补过的。
coat 意为“温暖”，抽象指它带来的那份暖意，父亲说 coat 就是那个冬天的全部。
coat 为抽象用法，指那份暖意本身，是一个冬天里人人都借、却没人质疑的东西。
coat 意为“外套、大衣”，到 1963 年这件 coat 成了报告里的一个数字。
coat 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个冬天和十一年的缝补。
coat 意为“外套”，我记得的是末尾那一件，1968 年补过，至今仍被说成全县最暖的。
coat 为抽象总称，祖母说一件外套是唯一会因为被认真缝补而变好的东西。
